title: BeeMyBlood: an open platform connecting blood donors, recipients and transfusion professionals in Switzerland
description:
BeeMyBlood is an open-source digital platform for the blood supply chain: a donor space (eligibility test, centres and collections, HémoRush game), a recipient space (transfusion journey, iron chelation, rights), a professional portal (stocks, cartography, rare phenotypes, digital twin with scenario simulation) and Claude-based BeeBot assistants aligned with the criteria of Transfusion CRS Suisse. It shows official daily data (blood-group barometer, collection dates, news) and runs an invitation-based alpha with email login and an on-screen confidentiality agreement.

Developed at Convivens Lab, Haute école de gestion de Genève (HES-SO), with the Geneva University Hospitals transfusion centre (CTS HUG), SIMED (University of Geneva) and Transfusion Interrégionale CRS. Live demo: beemyblood.ch.
